title: The customs quay
brief: A working seventeenth-century Caribbean port: limewashed ochre warehouses, shuttered arcades, terracotta roofs, palms, heavy mooring timbers and warm brass lamps beside the broad timber quay.

title: The broken cargo jetty
brief: Three storm-broken boardwalk spans on visibly rooted barnacled piles, a timber crane and suspended pallet, barrel stacks, a narrow optional salvage spar and small moored cargo lighters.

title: Beneath the fort
brief: A weathered limestone fort crowns the rocky headland; a narrow boardwalk turns beneath it into a timber-braced smugglers sea gate. Sunset over the open sea gives way to cool cave shade.

title: The smugglers fissure
brief: An old mining passage cut in wet layered limestone, crooked oak braces, bronze lanterns, rope and supply clutter. A narrow tidal fissure interrupts the worn trail; the far bank remains clearly visible.

title: The hidden crystal grotto
brief: An intimate secret alcove with restrained turquoise mineral seams, an abandoned expedition cache, damp stone shelves and old lantern glow. Curious Goonies treasure-hunt atmosphere.

title: The moonpool and the Drowned Crown
brief: A complete compact royal galleon rests inside the vast sea cavern: warm oak, crimson trim, a crowned stern and ragged ivory sails above turquoise water. The supported salvage pier enters a covered boarding passage leading into the larger playable wreck.

title: The giant bilge bowl
brief: A huge skate hold opens below the entry gallery: one continuous sixteen-metre transition, curved corners, brass coping and an unobstructed riding floor, with two elevated timber routes above.

title: Inside the skate bowl
brief: The broad bilge bowl invites long carves, airs and coping grinds. Cool clay-coloured riding surfaces contrast with original-proportion red oak, huge hull walls and warm gallery lanterns.

title: The starboard catwalk
brief: A complete Meshy timber catwalk runs high above the bowl. Broken spans and a rigging grind offer a harder optional line to the ship’s jewel.

title: The north return ramp
brief: A wide floor-level throat leaves the bowl and climbs gradually to the rear gallery. Players can finish the route without clearing a vertical wall, then return to skate freely.

title: The port rigging cache
brief: The port balcony contains the captain’s ledger bonus, supply crates and a broken timber crossing. The entire giant bowl stays visible below the high route.

title: The escape bridge
brief: The rear gallery meets the existing broken rope bridge and enclosed treasure passage; a readable jump leads to the king’s hoard.

title: The king's ransom
brief: The enclosed royal treasury remains the final destination, with banks of gold, jewelled chests and a crowned skull arch beyond the huge ship interior.
